paper_title: Axion dark matter: strings and their cores
notes: This is a theoretical/numerical simulation paper on axion cosmic string networks in the post-inflation PQ-breaking scenario. It does not present a new experimental exclusion limit or sensitivity projection. Its main quantitative result is a PREDICTION (not a bound): assuming axions are all of dark matter and K=8 production efficiency, fa = 3.3e11 GeV corresponding to ma = 18 ueV (1.8e-5 eV), with substantial systematic uncertainty since the physical log(ms*t) ~ 69 far exceeds the simulated range (~6-7.5). No exclusion-limit data points are extractable.
